spans.s:
guṇa-deva, m. Gunadeva, a pupil of
Gunādhya. [lit. ‘having virtue as his
god,’ 1302.]

guṇaśālin, a. possessing virtues, excellent.
 [see śālin.]

guṇāḍhya, m. Gunādhya, see 53^3N. [lit.
‘rich in virtue,’ āḍhya.]

guṇānvita, a. endowed with excellence;
(of an asterism) lucky. [anvita, √i.]
